title: l1qw.23.1: Define handoff state-transfer message format (link_epoch, link_seq, replay window)
description: Spec GCP-7.1: outgoing gateway transfers link replay state to incoming gateway. Define the CBOR wire format for (link_epoch, link_seq, replay_window_bitmap). No format exists in any language. Must carry enough state for the new gateway to initialize its link replay window without replaying old frames. Design doc + schema first.
